content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the MANUU Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 11th August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by MANUU?
faq.answer: Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) has announced a total of 10 vacancies for the posts of Caretaker, Electrician, and Plumber.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Caretaker post?
faq.answer: For the Caretaker post, candidates must possess a Bachelor Degree in any discipline from a recognized University, proficiency in computer operations, and knowledge of Urdu.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for these contractual positions will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 19525 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these MANUU jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted in Darbhanga, Bihar, with the pincode 846002. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual, as indicated in the recruitment details.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.
